🇺🇸🇷🇺 LAVROV ACCUSES US OF DIRECT INVOLVEMENT IN UKRAINIAN STRIKES ON RUSSIA

Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov has accused Washington of directly participating in Ukrainian strikes on Russian territory – while simultaneously confirming Russia's continued commitment to the understandings reached with Trump in Anchorage.

🎯 "The Americans, through arms supplies, intelligence, the Starlink system and much more, are not simply helping, but are directly participating in guiding Ukrainian weapons toward targets, including civilian targets, on Russian territory."

🤝 Despite this, Moscow remains committed to the Putin-Trump understandings from Anchorage last year. Lavrov confirmed Russia still regards those agreements as valid.

🧠 Russia intends to seek clarification from US Secretary of State Rubio on Washington's current position.
